weeks.content:
Point to head, tummy, hands and feet
My body can see, hear and touch

Eyes see, ears hear, nose smells
Tongue tastes, skin feels

Name red, blue, yellow and green
Find colours in class

Water flows and fills
Wet and dry sand

Name a big animal and a small one
Animal sounds

Name the dog, cat and bird
Animals we keep at home

A seed grows when we water it
Water the class plant

The sun gives light in the day
The moon and stars come at night

Touch warm water and cool water
The sun is hot, ice is cold

Walk and name what we see
Collect leaves and stones
